text:
Marta: FYI: docs snippet CI behavior update incoming. Please skim.

Raj: Short summary?

Marta: Inline code snippets in docs will now be executed with a 5s timeout (was 30s). This is to cut CI flakiness and speed reviews. Sample apps and hosted playgrounds unaffected.

Sam: OK. How should authors handle long examples?

Marta: Options: 1) shorten the snippet, 2) show mocked output, or 3) move the full run to sample-apps and link. We'll add examples in CONTRIBUTING.md.

docs-bot: Automation note: snippet-checker will enforce --timeout=5s for docs/** starting Mon. Failures post a bot comment with remediation links.

Raj: I'll update the docs PR template and the docs digest blurb.

Marta: Rollout: staging toggle next Monday, enforcement on main Wednesday. We'll monitor and adjust after one week. Ping me for exceptions.
